answer: Producing 60 answers an epoch thus costs 76 real forward passes, and the vine record lets any auditor recompute the check. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as a thread header. Replaying a stored transcript fails as the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a voyage spot-check that re-runs the prompt. That is 25 dollars per alias. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
